promoReadinessNotes: Global User Settings now owns account and app preferences only.
Creator broadcasts are visible, real, and managed from the Creator Dashboard.
Legacy creator settings routes redirect or explain the move instead of simulating creator controls.

checks.label: User settings contract exists and is user-only
evidence: User settings contract declares the canonical user-settings surface and blocks simulative tools.

checks.label: Creator dashboard settings contract exists
evidence: Creator dashboard tools are declared separately from global user settings.

checks.label: Global user settings contain only account and app preferences
evidence: User settings page renders the allowed account/preferences sections and a creator-dashboard CTA only.

checks.label: Creator dashboard settings hub exists and is operational
evidence: Creator dashboard settings hub shows the operational sections and truth labels.

checks.label: Creator request manager reads real backend data or says not connected
evidence: Creator request management is wired to the existing request route with request-id and pending guards.

checks.label: Creator booking manager reads real backend data or says not connected
evidence: Creator booking management is wired to the existing booking route with request-id and pending guards.

checks.label: Fan Pass subscriber visibility is read-only and route-backed
evidence: Fan Pass dashboard panel exposes subscriber rows only; membership mutations stay in public creator flows.

checks.label: Broadcast manager reads real backend data or says not live
evidence: Broadcast manager renders real collection state and the route writes live broadcast records.

checks.label: No simulated broadcast history remains canonical
evidence: Legacy simulated broadcast history is blocked/deprecated and the live manager is collection-backed.

checks.label: Old creator settings routes redirect or show migration notice
evidence: Legacy creator settings routes are redirected and the migration notice is explicit.

checks.label: Creator writes require ownership and admin projection is read-only
evidence: Creator settings and broadcasts validate ownership and block admin projection writes.

checks.label: Telemetry events exist for both surfaces
evidence: Telemetry catalog includes the required user-settings and creator-dashboard events.

checks.label: Docs were updated for the split
evidence: Agent-truth docs and surface doctrine reflect the split.

checks.label: Package script is wired
evidence: package.json exposes the settings split validator.
